one_liner: Cade Cunningham averages 9.3 assists per 36 minutes on top of 25.7 points -- the heaviest combined creation-and-scoring load in this player set.
three_things: 9.3 assists per 36 alongside 25.7 points is a full offensive-engine workload.
Rebounding adds 5.6 per 36 from the guard spot.
Efficiency is the trailing indicator: 46.1 percent from the field, 35.3 percent from three.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used. The 'heaviest in this set' comparison covers the players with insight files here, not the full atlas.
